# A Different Paper About Guidance Weights

## Abstract

<!-- anchor S1.p1 -->
Recent works vary the guidance weight throughout the diffusion process, and we study why this helps.

## 3 Schedulers

<!-- anchor S3.p1 -->
We find that a learned guidance network predicts a per-sample weight from the prompt embedding, which improves alignment without any retraining of the model.

<!-- anchor S3.p2 -->
Decreasing schedules, by contrast, tend to reduce diversity and harm the quality of the generated samples overall.
